title: The disgusting “closed off” or hidden bathroom.
content: I’ve visited many of the bathroom-scapes and chambers in the Mall World that I see many of you have. Most of the time, I am in a huge chamber/corridor-sized bathroom. Multiple stalls, toilets, urinals, showers, sinks, etc. It’s usually connected to locker rooms of a similar scale. The room is usually somewhat dim and steamy and wet. Usually there are other men in this bathroom but I don’t know any of them and the space is so huge that there’s not really any interaction. This huge ass bathroom has multiple zones and compartments - many having toilet clustered together out in the open with no dividers. Sometimes there are toilets for special needs individuals. The urinals are often different sizes and types. Both the urinals and toilets are either dirty or overflowing or both. I’m always searching for somewhere private and clean to piss. Last night, I was in one of the actual malls I visit in Mall World, when I discovered an old/ hidden/closed off, shuttered, and partially barricaded men’s room door. I was able to get around the barricade. I decided to go in, since I hadn’t been able to find another restroom. The room had an orange hue from the light, the sink and tile were like an old 70’s tan color. The white toilet had that awful black horseshoe seat. It was a single occupant bathroom. The room stunk, crusty dirty sink, had dirty mops and buckets in the corner and the water in the toilet was a horrid brownish black color. I did not use it. Has anyone else visited this horrific hidden bathroom?
